title: Power integral formula for the norm
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be any measure space, let $q>0$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^q(\mu)$. Then $N_q(X)^q=\int_\Omega |X(\omega)|^q\,d\mu(\omega)$.
replaced: Let $q>0$ and $X\in L^q(\mu)$ on an arbitrary measure space. Its finite real norm satisfies $\|X\|_q^q=\int|X|^q\,d\mu$.
